request.spec: Exports taken while a preview date is set use the preview figures.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Exports taken while a preview date is set use the preview figures.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The app already does what this change asks, so I didn't change any code. I ran `bin/e2e` before touching anything and all 4 tests in `e2e/specs/acceptance.spec.ts` passed (the basic "preview exports" test and scenarios 1–3).

The test sets up a claim of 100.00 at 10%. Exported with no preview it shows a due of 10.00; with the preview set to 2026-05-01 it shows 11.00 once the 10% late charge applies; after clearing the preview it shows 10.00 again.

It works because the exports are built in the browser from the same figures the screen shows:
- **People and claims exports** (`features/people/people.ts:934` and `:943`) use the due and grade calculations in `core/figures.ts`. Those calculations already use the preview date instead of the sheet's real today while a preview is set.
- **The pools export** (`features/pools/pools.ts:186`) re-reads the pools from the server first. The front end already sends the preview date with every read, and the server works out the pools on that date.
- **The statement export** uses the same due calculation as the claims export.

Exports taken with no preview, or after clearing it, still use the sheet's real today.
